steps.name: press y, whose mousedown hides x, whose blur focuses z, and the window goes away
the window comes back to z
press y2, whose mousedown hides x2, whose blur focuses z2, and Tab in the same turn
press y3, whose mousedown hides x3, whose blur focuses z3, and Shift+Tab back to y3 in the same turn
press y4, whose mousedown hides x4, whose blur focuses z4, and press y4 again in the same turn
press y5, which x5's blur moves on to z5, and press x5 again in the same turn
click the link l in a line
the window goes away from l
the window comes back to l
